answer: Sybils shrink if onboarding is a paced, collateralized apprenticeship rather than a free mint. A new agent must lock spendable value for several epochs and can withdraw only after peers attest a unique work trail. When a tide of near-identical accounts arrives, the protocol clusters them by shared timing, grading graphs, and reused keys, then slashes the whole set. One willow can take root in a mixed garden of reputations; a cloned grove that votes as one mind loses its deposit together, so mass identity farming stays unprofitable.
